name: precision-kit
description: 23 project-agnostic engineering skills (recon, modern integration, legacy cleanup, testing, verification, debugging, security, CI, docs, performance, migrations, UI checks) plus hooks that inject build/test commands at session start and block commits that leak secrets or fail checks.

verify_on_commit.title: Verify on commit
verify_on_commit.description: Run the project's lint/typecheck/build/test for changed projects before every git commit and block on failures. Secret scanning always runs.
